pr_title: catalog: add support for replicating catalogs for reader virtual clusters
pr_body:
This patch adds logic for extracting and creating a PCR reader catalog. This patch will do the following:

1. Introduce a new catalog function catalog.SetupOrAdvanceStandbyReaderCatalog which can be used to advanced or setup a reader catalog from a source tenant.
2. Add logic to allow read only sequence access, so that SQL behaves correctly

Fixes: #129439

Note: The first commit in this PR can be ignored, and will be merged via a separate PR https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/130183
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/130184)

issue_context.title: sql/catalog: extract and insert catalogs across tenants to enable PCR select from standby
issue_context.body:
Add support for extracting and replicating catalogs across tenants for PCR work. As a part of this work we will:

1. Extract a catologue out of offline tenant key span
2. Inject a catalogue into reader tenant key space
3. Move the catalogue timestamp in reader tenant key space.

See: https://cockroachlabs.atlassian.net/browse/CRDB-37521

Jira issue: CRDB-41544

Epic CRDB-37521
